구간당 경험 {0}{1} · 완주 시 학원 명성 +{2}: Per stage: EXP {0}{1} · Academy Fame +{2} for a full clear

입학 시 정해지며 바뀌지 않는다: Set at enrollment and never changes
성격은 입학할 때 멘탈리티에 한 번 반영되고, 상담에서 어떤 말이 통하는: Personality shapes Stats once at enrollment, and decides which words get through in counseling.
진로 평가는 대회 성적과 원정 성과로만 쌓인다: Career Rating builds only through tournament results and expeditions
신입생은 평가 0에서 시작한다. 원정은 원정지마다 정해진 상한까지만 올려: New students start at a rating of 0. Expeditions only raise it up to each site's cap; going beyond that takes tournaments. Entering a tournament without winning a single match lowers the rating.
업보가 쌓이면 평가와 무관하게 이쪽으로 갈린다: With enough karma, students end up here regardless of rating
업보는 <b>안개 낀 옛 성터 이상의 원정</b>에서 구간마다 쌓인다 (: Karma builds up each stage on expeditions to the Misty Castle Ruins or beyond (Ruins {0} · Bell Tower {1} · Rift {2} · Tomb {3}). Donating {4} G to the church cleanses {5} karma from every student (once per half-season).
학원의 마스터 부임, 축하합니다!: Congratulations on becoming the academy's Master!
Place training cards on the five weekdays, then run the week.
스케줄 버튼을 눌러 일과 짜기: Tap Schedule to plan the week
오른쪽 메뉴 맨 아래 스케줄 버튼을 누르면 학생들의 일과를 짤 수 있어요: Tap the Schedule button at the bottom of the right-hand menu to plan your students' week.
폰에서는 카드를 누르면 첫 빈 요일에 들어갑니다. 원하는 요일로 끌어 놓: On a phone, tapping a card puts it in the first empty day. You can also drag it to any day you like.
다섯 칸을 채우고 진행 버튼에 표시된 비용을 확인하세요. 놓은 카드를 누: Fill all five slots and check the cost shown on the Run Week button. Tap a placed card to take it back out.
같은 색이 이어지면 +{0}%씩, 최대 +{1}%. 원정 카드는 체인이: Each same-color streak adds +{0}%, up to +{1}%. Expedition cards don't continue a chain.
오후에는 무엇을 할까요?: What to do in the afternoon?
Choose each afternoon from Auto · Train · Rest · Errands.
그날 가장 약한 멘탈리티를 집중 훈련합니다. 진행 화면이나 학생 화면에서: Focus-trains that day's weakest Stat. You can change afternoon activities on the Schedule or Students screen.
휴식으로 지정한 학생은 학원 스케줄에 참여하지 않고 쉽니다. 의뢰는 열린: Students set to Rest skip the academy schedule and take it easy. Errands can be chosen once unlocked, but not in summer.
컨디션이 낮아질수록 효율이 떨어집니다. 진행 전에 학생의 컨디션을 살펴보: The lower the Condition, the lower the efficiency. Check your students' Condition before running the week.
Stats built through training shape battle and growth.
학생 화면에서 멘탈리티를 보고 훈련을 계획하세요. 개인 행동을 훈련으로: Check Stats on the Students screen and plan training. Setting the afternoon to Train works on weak spots.
잠재력은 입학 등급으로 정해지는 성장 폭과 한계입니다. 여섯 훈련 능력과: Potential is the growth range and ceiling set by a student's enrollment grade. Don't confuse it with the six trainable qualities.
가을 대회를 향해 한 걸음씩: Step by step toward the Fall tournaments
Raise your students, build teams, and go for the Academy Festival Finals title.
Check who's playing and the formation, and look after Condition and relics.
시내 대회부터 차근차근 도전합니다. 다음 대회 초대 조건은 게임의 안내에: Start with the City Tournament and work your way up. The in-game guides show what earns an invitation to the next tournament.
Results aren't everything — manage your funds too. Keep an eye on upkeep and debt.
Two students who keep an eye on each other grow faster when they train together.
개인 행동에서 라이벌 두 명을 모두 훈련으로 지정하세요. 두 사람이 함께: Set both rivals' afternoons to Train. They'll pick a weak area to work on together.
같은 분야에서 성장 보너스: Growth bonus in the same area
둘이 같은 분야를 개인 훈련하면 해당 멘탈리티 성장이 {0}% 증가합니다: When the two train the same area, that Stat grows {0}% more.
한쪽이 휴식이나 의뢰를 하면 함께 훈련하는 조건이 달라집니다. 두 학생의: If one of them rests or runs an errand, they won't train together. Check both students' activities.
원정에서 얻고, 장착해요: Win them on expeditions, then equip them
Play a Send Expedition card to pick a site and a team; the battles then run automatically.
원정지와 팀 선택: Pick a site and a team
난이도와 팀 상태를 보고 출발하세요. 결과로 건너뛰기를 눌러 전투 결과를: Check the difficulty and your team's state before you set out. Tap Skip to Results to see how the battles went right away.
원정 보상으로 얻은 유물은 유물 · 스킬 화면에서 확인하고 학생에게 장착: Relics from expeditions show up on the Relics · Skills screen — equip them on your students there.
원정에서는 자금·유물·진로 평가와 함께 업보도 얻습니다. 반복 파견 전에: Expeditions bring funds, relics, and Career Rating — and karma too. Check your students before sending them out again.
친선전, 상대와 날짜를 골라요: Friendly Matches: pick opponents and dates
Choose opponents from the academies that asked, and slot them into the second half of Spring.
상대와 명성 변화 확인: Check the opponent and the Fame at stake
Look at the opponent's strength and how much Fame a win or loss moves, then accept.
빈 일정에 배치하고 회신: Place it on an open date and reply
학원을 고른 뒤 날짜에 놓습니다. 끌어서 배치하거나 눌러서 고를 수 있어: Pick an academy, then set it on a date. Drag it there or tap to choose.
모든 요청을 받을 필요는 없습니다. 일정을 비워 두거나 요청을 거절해도: You don't have to accept every request. It's fine to leave dates open or decline.
Choose your words based on both teams' strength and your students' personalities.
Words that fit the moment help students' mood and trust.
동기부여는 특히 성격을 살펴보세요. 맞지 않는 말은 기분을 떨어뜨릴 수도: With Motivation especially, mind their personalities. The wrong words can bring their mood down.
예시 수치가 항상 보장되는 보상은 아닙니다. 현재 학생들의 반응을 확인하: The example numbers aren't guaranteed rewards. Watch how your students actually react.
졸업 뒤에도, 함께하는 리그: A league that goes on after graduation
졸업생이 생기면 더 넓은 무대에서 다른 학원과 모의 대전을 펼칠 수 있어: Once you have graduates, they can face other academies in simulated matches on a bigger stage.
In the League's Entry tab, pick the graduates and formation to field, then enter.
리그와 SP 상점 이용: Use the league and the SP Shop
리그를 진행하며 SP를 얻고 리그의 SP 상점 탭에서 사용하세요. 폰에서: Earn SP as the league plays out and spend it in the League's SP Shop tab. On a phone, find League under the More menu.
리그는 온라인 기능입니다. 등록·시즌 정산 조건과 결과는 해당 화면에서: The league is an online feature. Check that screen for entry and season-settlement rules and results.
부지를 넓히고 시설을 들여요: Expand the grounds and add facilities
Your Fame-based charter and Academy Expansion are separate steps.
첫 증축은 시내 대회 참가 뒤: First expansion after the City Tournament
Under the current rules, the Town and the first expansion open after your first City Tournament.
이후에는 인가와 자금 확인: After that, check your charter and funds
증축 단계마다 필요한 학원 등급과 비용이 다릅니다. 조건을 채우고 증축하: Each expansion step needs a different charter and cost. Meet the conditions and expand to unlock more facilities and items.
인가를 받았다고 모든 시설이 바로 열리지는 않습니다. 각 시설에 표시된: A new charter doesn't open every facility right away. Check the expansion requirement shown on each facility.
3학년의 겨울은 진로 준비: A 3rd-year's winter is for career prep
3rd-years spend winter preparing for life after graduation.
겨울 스케줄에서 빠져요: They sit out the winter schedule
3학년 학생들이 훈련에 보이지 않아도 오류가 아닙니다. 남은 재학생 중심: It's not a bug if 3rd-years don't show up in training. Plan around the students who remain.
Everything they've grown into and achieved leads to career announcements and graduation.
학생들의 마지막 가을을 미리 준비해 주세요. 겨울에는 신입생을 맞을 다음: Prepare for your students' last Fall ahead of time. In winter you can also plan the next year and its new students.
카드의 작은 표식을 확인해요: Check the small marks on cards
The same training card can work differently on the day it's used, depending on its mark.
사용하는 날에 적용: Applies on the day it's used
표식은 카드를 들고 있는 동안이 아니라, 해당 요일에 사용했을 때 적용됩: A mark takes effect when the card is used on its day, not while it sits in your hand.
카드 왼쪽 위 남은 기간도 확인하세요. 이번 주까지인 카드는 사용하지 않: Check the time left at the card's top left too. A card marked Last wk disappears at the end of the week if unused.
마을 의뢰는 쌓일수록 든든해요: Town errands pay off the more you run
학생의 개인 행동을 의뢰로 두면 오후마다 마을 사람들의 일을 돕고 보수를: Set a student's afternoon to Errands and they'll help the townsfolk each afternoon and get paid.
진행 화면이나 학생 화면에서 개인 행동을 의뢰로 바꾸세요. 임의로 둔 학: Switch afternoons to Errands on the Schedule or Students screen. Students on Auto also run errands about half the time when their Condition is 70+.
의뢰 하루마다 컨디션이 {0} 줄고 보수(처음 {1} G)를 받아요. 이: Each day of errands costs {0} Condition and earns pay ({1} G at first). This week's errand is set before the week starts, so the Schedule screen shows ahead of time which Stat goes up and which goes down.
의뢰처마다 누적 {0}회 · {1}회를 넘기면 그 의뢰의 등급이 올라 보: Once a client passes {0} · {1} total errands, that errand ranks up and pay rises to {2} G · {3} G a day. Totals are counted separately for each client. At {4} · {5} errands for a client, they'll reward you with something special.
학생 한 명이 하루 의뢰를 마칠 때마다 1회씩 쌓여요. 여러 명이 함께: Each day one student finishes an errand counts as 1. More students working together build it up faster. No errands in summer.
지침을 어긴 학생, 이유부터 들어 봐요: A student ignored orders? Hear them out first
Now and then, a student does something other than that week's afternoon orders.
경과 보고에서 확인: See it in the Progress Report
결산 창에 빨간 글씨로 알려 줘요. 지침을 무시한 학생은 그 주에 바꾼: The weekly summary flags it in red. For a student who ignored orders, the activity they switched to that week drains Condition ×2 and recovers only half.
상담 탭에서 이유를 물어요: Ask why in the Counsel tab
학생의 대답을 듣고 세 가지 말 중 하나를 골라요. 상담하지 않고 다음: Hear the student's answer and pick one of three replies. Start the next week without counseling and they'll ignore orders again.
성격에 맞는 말을 골라요: Pick words that fit their personality
맞는 말이면 멘탈리티 · 컨디션 · 신뢰가 오르고 앞으로 한동안 지침을: The right words raise Stats, Condition, and Trust, and they'll follow orders for a while. The wrong ones lower Trust — they'll follow for now, but not for long.
Leadership · Insight · Charisma work just as they do in Concern counseling.
배치 예시 · 카드를 누르면 첫 빈칸으로: Example · tapping a card sends it to the first empty slot
같은 색을 다섯 날 이어 놓은 예시: Example: the same color five days in a row
전력과 명성 변화 확인: Check strength and Fame at stake
빈 날짜에 놓기: Set it on an open date
진로 준비로 스케줄 불참: Skip the schedule for career prep
계속 훈련하고 다음 해 준비: Keep training and prepare for next year
의뢰처 여섯 곳 · 지금 등급과 도운 횟수: Six clients · current rank and errands run
{0}회 · {1}회를 채운 의뢰처는 의뢰인이 보답해요. 새 상점이나 식: Clients reward you at {0} · {1} errands. New shops or meal plans open up, and prices may drop.
의뢰 등급 · 의뢰처마다 따로 쌓여요: Errand ranks · counted separately per client
Errands are only possible once town errands open up, and never in summer.
